bds.h: Nvidia, CEO Huang sued over disclosures related to suspected Chinese spy
bds.lede: Nvidia and Chief Executive Jensen Huang were sued on Monday in a proposed class action accusing them of defrauding shareholders by concealing Huang’s ties with a suspected Chinese spy.
rows: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing fresh turmoil after shareholders sued him and his company for allegedly misleading them over his affair with an accused Chinese spy​.
Nvidia and Chief Executive Jensen Huang were sued on Monday in a proposed class action accusing them of defrauding shareholders by concealing Huang’s ties with a suspected Chinese spy.

Video. US President Donald Trump says the FBI is looking into a matter involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and alleged links to a Chinese government agent. Trump said he had spoken to Huang, who denied knowing the person was a spy, and expressed confidence in the tech executive.

Lawmakers, investors and tech leaders are assessing bombshell revelations about Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang. Huang admitted to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy. Nvidia designs chips and processors that power artificial intelligence and underpin much of the enormous…

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has helmed the company since starting it in 1993, guiding it from a graphics card maker to the AI behemoth it is today. But with an investigation now underway into whether Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort and no clear successor in sight, analysts say a…
Huang also has a close relationship with President Donald Trump and has pushed Trump to ease export restrictions on Nvidia chips to China.
